decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed increase in the height of the parapet wall at second-floor level to the rear and side elevations, by reason of its scale, height and design, would form a visually prominent and unsympathetic addition that would fail to appear subordinate to the host property. The development would result in an uncharacteristically high parapet wall and a disproportionate expanse of blank brickwork, appearing out of keeping with the established character and appearance of the terrace. The proposal would therefore cause harm to the character and appearance of the subject property, the terrace and the street scene, contrary to the provisions of policy LP1 and LP5 of the Local Plan (2023), the Housing SPD (2016) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

Reason : 2 - The proposed removal of the privacy screen and replacement with lower metal railings on the rear elevation of the existing second floor roof terrace would compromise the visual amenity of adjoining sites through altering the level of privacy and overlooking to neighbouring properties to an unacceptable degree contrary to the provisions of policy LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan (2023), the Housing SPD (2016) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description: Alterations including raising of parapet wall at second floor level to rear and side elevations to provide a wind break
